title: Skyrim Immersive Creatures Special Edition - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 1 NPC from Skyrim Immersive Creatures Special Edition.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Skyrim Immersive Creatures Special Edition (Skyrim Immersive Creatures Special Edition.esp).

Install this if Skyrim Immersive Creatures Special Edition.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
author: skyrimnet
